California Gov. Gavin Newsom:
This guy thought he could play second fiddle to all of that. And as we've seen over and over again, there's only one Donald Trump. 
There's a cult of Trump personality.
Those that try to be derivative of Trump usually end up in very bad shape. He's unworthy of the position.

Israeli Diaspora Affairs Minister Amichai Chikli:
You sit in television studios and they tell you that the AfD in Germany is a Nazi party.
The AfD is a party established 20 or 25 years ago by economists. It is light-years away from being Nazi.
It is not a Nazi party. Nothing of the sort.

Israeli Diaspora Affairs Minister Amichai Chikli:
I brought Santiago Abascal, the leader of Spain's Vox party, to Israel.
The Foreign Ministry bureaucracy was appalled by the relationship with Vox and really didn't want it.
I said: I don't care what the agenda of the Foreign Ministry bureaucrats is.
If this man stands with us against Hamas, against insane immigration into their country, and understands the implications of masses of immigrants who don't identify with the country at all, then we should work with him.
